title: Initial stored energy
description: Essential: The answer must give the total energy stored in the capacitor before fluid rise as U = (π ε₀ l / log(b/a)) V².

title: Fluid rise height
description: Essential: The answer must give the equilibrium fluid height as h = ε₀ (κ-1) V² / [log(b/a) ρ g (b² - a²)].

title: Pressure difference
description: Essential: The answer must give the pressure difference as P = (ρ g l / 2) - [ε₀ V² (κ-1) / ((b² - a²) log(b/a))].

title: Energy minimization reasoning
description: Important: The solution must apply an energy minimization principle, setting the derivative of total energy with respect to fluid height to zero.

title: Capacitance with dielectric
description: Important: The solution must correctly model the capacitance as a function of the fluid height y, combining vacuum and dielectric-filled parts.

title: Work-energy equivalence
description: Important: For part (c), the solution must equate the work done by the pressure difference to the change in total system energy.

title: Gravitational potential energy
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly calculate the gravitational potential energy of the fluid column as (1/2)ρg y² π(b² - a²).

title: Sign error in energy terms
description: Pitfall: A common error is mishandling the signs of battery work and field energy in the total energy expression.

title: Incorrect field or capacitance
description: Pitfall: A common error is using the wrong expression for the electric field or capacitance of a cylindrical capacitor.
